description: Generate memorable, strong passphrases from real words — choose word count, separator and capitalization, with entropy shown.

faqs.a: Four or more random words give 50+ bits of entropy — strong and memorable. Six words is excellent.
faqs.q: How many words should I use?

faqs.a: Yes — the estimated entropy in bits is shown for every passphrase.
A built-in list of 120 common English words — no repeats within a passphrase.
One tap copies the passphrase to your clipboard.

howto: Pick a separator and capitalization style.
Copy the passphrase and store it in a password manager.
title: Passphrase Generator
